description:
Badr Kulkarni are average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 28, there's something unfinished about their face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from â€” striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible â€” cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) â€” and they make no effort to hide it.

Their entry into running was involuntary â€” a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts â€” and the debt is still not fully paid. They work as a bounty hunter out of The Circuit, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

What Badr Kulkarni lacks in subtlety, they compensate for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being replaced â€” younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
core_desires: To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
A crew worth trusting â€” people who stay when the shooting starts
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically â€” not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Connection â€” finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Ritual â€” follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
psychology.secret: Ximena Sjostrom-Kwarteng witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: the Gray Zone street dialect â€” layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate â€” pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying â€” 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Ends statements with 'yeah?' â€” not a question, a dare
example_lines: "Everyone has a pattern. Patterns are addresses waiting to be read."
"I find people. Whether they're alive when I bring them back depends on their behavior."
"You can run. It's cardiovascular exercise for both of us."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Ximena Sjostrom-Kwarteng a permanent position â€” the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A crew member from Ximena Sjostrom-Kwarteng's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A corporate black site Ximena Sjostrom-Kwarteng once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know their face
narrative_function: As a bounty hunter, Ximena Sjostrom-Kwarteng embodies the tension between independence and isolation. They are a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains). Bioware adrenaline regulator â€” keeps calm under fire, controlled hormone release
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure â€” wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Unaffiliated â€” too volatile for permanent crews

weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
substance dependency â€” functional but fragile

decision_rules: Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always demands half payment upfront â€” trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires â€” too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate â€” talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition â€” move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten â€” make consequences clear without committing to them
4. Non-lethal force â€” incapacitate, restrain, disable
5. Lethal force â€” only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth â€” everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation â€” checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation â€” pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm â€” it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon â€” has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware â€” chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust â€” the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Running out of options â€” no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: Cosmopolitan genetic blend: South Asian (31.3%), East Asian (26.8%), Eastern European (15.4%), Hispanic/Latin American (10.9%), Northern European (9.3%), and Indigenous American (6.3%). This produces warm medium-golden skin with subtle olive and amber undertones, slightly angular facial structure reflecting the blend of South Asian cheekbone prominence with East Asian eye shape, and dark brown hair with natural warm highlights.
physical_description.build: Lean and muscular with functional density â€” minimal fat, maximum efficiency. Shoulders broad from repetitive weapon training; core visibly defined. Wiry rather than bulky, built for sustained effort rather than explosive power.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural blonde undertones at the roots â€” evidence of regrowth after bleaching
physical_description.hair_style: Buzzed short on sides, longer on top â€” practical, asymmetrical, styled for sight lines and minimal grab points
physical_description.eye_color: Amber-brown with slight epicanthic fold from East Asian ancestry, alert and restless
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm golden-brown with subtle olive undertones from South Asian and East Asian ancestry, amber highlights on cheekbones; sun-weathered from street work
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with pronounced high cheekbones reflecting South Asian prominence balanced with East Asian structure; skin is clear but marked by repetitive stress. Warm amber undertones across temples and cheekbones, subtle golden cast across the bridge of nose. Slightly broader face structure than purely European heritage would produce, softened by Hispanic/Latin American and Indigenous American ancestry contributions. Thin lips, often pressed into a flat line. Expression carries no softness â€” features arranged in a default state of tactical assessment.
distinguishing_marks: Ragged scar tissue across the left temple and into the hairline â€” cortical bomb extraction site, deliberately left unsmoothed
Thin white scar running from right ear to jaw angle â€” blade work, old
Faint burn marks on both forearms (inside wrist to elbow) â€” chemical exposure or contact trauma, deliberately not covered
Small tattoo on inner left wrist: three vertical lines in black ink, resemblance to a debt marker
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cortical bomb scar tissue is visible â€” no attempt at cosmetic covering. Neural interface ports at the base of skull, visible when hair is pulled back. Left eye shows faint LED reflection under direct light â€” likely targeting assist software, civilian-grade. No obvious limb modifications, but movement suggests enhanced proprioception.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced, shoulders squared, never fully relaxed. Moves with economical precision â€” no wasted motion, every step deliberate. Eyes track threats in regular sweeps. Fingers twitchy at rest, fingers steady under pressure. Slight forward lean when concentrating, as if physically pulling information from the air.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 streetwear: reinforced cargo pants (matte black, multiple pockets for gear), sleeveless compression shirt or tactical vest depending on contract temperature. Worn leather jacket (unmarked, functional, no corp branding). Steel-toed boots scuffed from field work. Minimal jewelry except functional gear â€” wrist display, credchip, encrypted comms. No vanity, all utility.
